_about: High or critical npm advisories with no fixed release yet. scripts/check-cves.py lets these through and fails on any other. Remove an entry as soon as a fix ships. Checked 2026-10-23.

advisories.reason: No fixed release (1.4.0 is the latest). Comes in through @expo/code-signing-certificates in the Expo CLI and expo-updates' build tooling, used when signing updates at build time; it isn't in the app on phones.

Fixed only in zod 4, and the Expo CLI (@expo/cli 57 and the newest, 58.1.15) still needs zod 3 (^3.25.76), which has no fixed release. Zod 3 is used only by the Expo CLI and ESLint on a developer's computer or Expo's build servers, on the CLI's own config and inputs; it isn't in the app on phones. Remove once @expo/cli moves to zod 4.
